segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the final scope before I send the order form through deal desk. I have 42 standard seats, 6 admin seats, and the implementation package with two onsite days in May. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches what we have. The only change is we want the admin seats all active on day one, but probably only 35 of the standard seats at go-live. The remaining 7 can be provisioned later.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For billing, it’ll still show 48 total seats on the annual subscription, but we can note the phased provisioning in the onboarding notes. The start date we had was May 15, with go-live targeted for June 10. Does that still work on your side?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: June 10 is still the date. Our IT team asked if the kickoff can be the week of May 20 instead of May 16. They’re tied up with a network change that Thursday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, no issue. I can put kickoff on May 21 at 1 p.m. Eastern. The two onsite days would then be June 4 and June 5, unless you want those closer to go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: June 4 and 5 are fine. On the contract, procurement asked about the auto-renewal language. They’re okay with annual renewal, but they want 60 days’ notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s a standard fallback for us. I’ll mark 60 days in the order form and have legal confirm, but I don’t expect a problem. Pricing stays at $31,680 for the subscription and $7,500 for implementation, so $39,180 total before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And invoices, can those be split? We need the subscription invoiced on signature and the implementation invoiced after the kickoff.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I’ll set it up in the billing tool as two invoices: $31,680 on signature, then $7,500 on May 21. Payment terms are net 30 on both. Do you need a PO before we countersign?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, we’ll issue a PO once we have the order form. Send it to me and copy Mark in procurement, and we should be able to turn it around by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send the revised order form today by 3 p.m. Central, with the 60-day renewal notice, May 15 start date, and the invoice split. If anything changes on the seat list, just send me the spreadsheet before kickoff.
